headline: Approved July minutes and the financial report; lower lunch and bingo attendance was discussed.
summary: Updates covered a sold-out Sept 25 senior picnic, new programs, and a travel club trip to the JFK library. Lunch and grab-and-go numbers are down, and bingo attendance is down too. Ideas raised included a survey on popular menu items and simpler meal names.
decisions: Approved the July minutes as amended; the vote was unanimous.
Approved the financial report; the vote was unanimous.

Motion to approve financial report by Cappie, second by Wayne, approved by all.

plain_text:
Minutes  
Holyoke COA Board of Directors Meeting  
Friday September 11th, 2026  
ATTENDANCE: Barbara Grady, Kyong Cruz, Nikki Perrier, Len Brouillette, Wayne Klinge, Priscilla 
Garcia, Dian McCollum, Julita Rojas, Cappie Glica, and Navae Rodriguez, Exec. Director  
Meeting called to order by Barbara at 10:05 am. 
 
Minutes for July were approved as amended. Motion by Wayne, second by Len, approved by all.  
Financial Report: Our energy line was well funded this year, but it will be hard to predict because 
we don’t know what winter will look like. Gifts and contributions do not reflect accurate balance, as 
last year’s balance has not rolled over.  Motion to approve financial report by Cappie, second by 
Wayne, approved by all.  
Old Business:  
 Program update: Senior picnic coming up Sept 25 is sold out. New programs are going 
well. Travel club is coming along, upcoming trip to the JFK library.  
 Building updates: Reached out to Dean Tech to see if the students would be able to work 
on the woodworking project for the lobby.  
 Staffing updates: current, no staffing needs. 
New Business  
 The board had an extensive discussion about why numbers for lunch and grab and go are 
down. Pricing is still very affordable at $3 per meal. Discussed to see if a survey could be 
created to see what items are most popular.  Looked at the current menus that were posted 
online and noticed that there were no repeats, which is good in terms of variety, but 
perhaps people would like to see popular items more often.  This is where the survey would 
be helpful.  Discussed the names of the meals, perhaps making the description simpler. 
 Another item that was noted is that numbers for bingo attendance are also down. 
 
Meeting adjourned 10:45 am 
 
Respectfully submitted by,  
Kyong M Cruz 
Secretary 
Approved as amended 10/09/2026
